title: Per-tenant SLIs and cardinality-aware logging strategy for analytics ingestion & query pipeline
creator: Asha Patel
description: Problem: The analytics ingestion and query pipeline currently exposes only global SLIs and coarse dashboards. This masks tenant-level regressions (e.g., heavy customers who experience periodic latency spikes or higher error rates) and drives noisy on-call pages. Goal: Define, implement, and roll out per-tenant SLIs/SLOs and a cardinality-aware logging strategy that enables actionable per-tenant observability without causing telemetry cost blowups or unbounded index cardinality. Deliverables: (1) telemetry contract (SLI definitions, trace/span naming, log fields and hashing rules), (2) data pipeline changes to emit tenant-aware metrics and sampled traces, (3) dashboards and alerting per-tenant (top-N + rollup views), and (4) rollout/guardrails to protect telemetry cost and privacy.
acceptance_criteria: SLI definitions published and reviewed by SRE/Observability and PM (latency p95, p50; success rate; ingestion lag; freshness)
Per-tenant SLIs available in metrics backend for top-100 tenants and via rollup for others
Tracing changes propagate tenant_id and query_id as hashed identifiers; end-to-end traces for sampled requests can be correlated to metrics
Logging changes implement cardinality controls: tenant_id hashed, query_text redacted, explicit indexed tags limited to 10 high-value keys
Dashboards: (a) tenant-summary view showing top-100 tenants by traffic and key SLO breaches; (b) rollup view by region/model showing normalized SLI trends
Alerting: automated page for customer-impacting SLO breaches (high) and low-priority anomalies routed to console-observability channel
Telemetry cost estimate updated and within 15% of approved budget after sampling & rollup applied
Doc page with instrumentation guide, sampling policy, and runbook published
implementation_plan: Week 1: Finalize SLI definitions with SRE/PM; mock dashboards and get PM sign-off
Week 2: Instrument ingestion service to emit per-tenant metrics and hashed tenant_id in traces/logs; add event tags for batch size and source partition
Week 3: Implement cardinality controls in logging library (hashing, redaction, allowed-indexed-keys list) and deploy to staging
Week 4: Pipeline transforms: add metric rollups (top-N tenants + default rollup bucket), store per-tenant daily aggregates, integrate with metrics backend
Week 5: Tracing: set sampling policies (1% global, 10% for top-100 tenants, 100% for debug-mode tenants), update span conventions, and add trace->metric linking via hashed query_id
Week 6: Dashboards & alerts: build tenant-summary and rollup dashboards; create alert rules and on-call escalation mapping
Week 7: Gradual rollout to production with canary tenants, monitor telemetry costs and hit acceptance criteria
telemetry_spec: SLIs: ingestion_ingest_latency_p95 (ms), query_exec_latency_p95 (ms), query_success_rate (1 - error_rate), ingestion_processing_lag_p99 (s), freshness_minutes_p90
Per-tenant labels: tenant_hash (SHA256 hex, 8 chars), region, model_variant, route
Metric export: top-N per-tenant metrics exported at 1m resolution; all other tenants aggregated into 'other_tenants' rollup
Tracing: span name conventions 'ingest.receive', 'ingest.transform', 'pipeline.materialize', 'query.execute'; propagate tenant_hash and traceable query_hash
Trace sampling: default 1% global, 10% for top-N tenants, 100% for debug/on-request traces; sampled traces include full span stack and hashed query_id

Logs: structured JSON with fields {timestamp, level, tenant_hash, service, route, event, error_code}; query_text redacted; only allow list-of-indexed-keys: [tenant_hash, service, error_code, route, region]
Retention & cost controls: metrics 90d hot/360d cold; traces 30d; logs 30d indexed, 365d archive; alert when projected telemetry spend > budget threshold
rollout_plan: Stage 0 (staging): validate telemetry schema and dashboards against synthetic load
Stage 1 (canary): enable per-tenant metrics for 10 low-risk tenants and 2 internal tenants; validate sampling and cost forecasts
Stage 2 (scale): expand to top-100 tenants by traffic, enable dashboard auto-population
Stage 3 (full): enable rollup buckets for all other tenants and switch alerting to production rules
Fallback: revert per-tenant export and increase sampling if telemetry costs exceed threshold or if dashboard queries cause backend overload
risks_and_mitigation: High telemetry cost if per-tenant cardinality uncontrolled -> mitigate with top-N + rollup, hashing, and sampling
Privacy leak via raw identifiers -> require hashing and redaction in logs and traces; review by privacy lead
Performance overhead from instrumentation -> limit metric cardinality at emitting service and use async batching
Incomplete adoption across services -> add SDK changes, lint rules, and pre-deploy checks to enforce field names
testing_and_validation: Load-test ingest path with synthetic tenants to verify 1m metric resolution and rollup correctness
Inject fault scenarios (partial downstream failure) to validate SLO alerting and on-call paging
Smoke-test dashboards for top-100 tenants and validate links from tenant rows to sampled traces
Telemetry cost simulation using 90-day projection tool before widening rollout
